title: Wasiƙu, saƙonni da labarai
description: Ten short stories about letters, messages and media: a young comedian's video in Kano, civil-war letters dug up in a Kaduna backyard, a radio debate on the rice trade, a visa interview at an embassy in Abuja, a folk tale about the Hare and the Snake told on Sokoto radio, a Christmas play and anniversary at a church in Jos, a young mother's letter from Katsina to her husband in Jidda, a trader's letter to a newspaper about a market rebuilding that keeps being postponed, a television hadith contest in Sokoto, and a pilot's message that calms a youth football team on a stormy flight.

lessons.title: Faifan barkwancin Mu'awiya
lessons.summary: In Kano, Mu'awiya loves comedy; he practises an old trader's looks in front of a mirror, his sister makes a blunder and records nothing, the second video is copied and shared everywhere, the trader himself laughs, and a radio station gives Mu'awiya a show.
lessons.text:
Mu'awiya saurayi ne ɗan shekara goma sha tara, kuma yana zaune a Kano tare da iyayensa da ƙanwarsa Jauhara. Tun yana ƙarami yana son barkwanci. Malamansa sukan ce, "Wannan yaro yana da hazaka. Hazakarsa ta barkwanci za ta kai shi nesa."

Wata rana Mu'awiya ya ce wa Jauhara, "Ina so in yi faifan bidiyo na barkwanci, in aika wa mutane ta waya." Jauhara ta ce, "To, zan taimake ka. Zan ɗauki bidiyon da wayata."

Kafin su fara, Mu'awiya ya tsaya a gaban babban madubi a ɗakinsa. Yana so ya yi kwaikwayon wani tsohon ɗan kasuwa na unguwarsu, Malam Barde. Ya sa babbar riga da hula kamar ta Malam Barde, sannan ya duba kamanninsa a cikin madubin. Ya motsa leɓensa, ya tura leɓen gaba kamar tsoho, ya yi magana a hankali. Ya maimaita haka a gaban madubin sau goma, har kamanninsa suka yi kama da na Malam Barde sosai.

Da suka shirya, Jauhara ta ce, "Ka shirya? Zan danna wayar yanzu." Ta danna allon wayar, sai Mu'awiya ya fara. Ya yi barkwanci na minti biyar da kuzari sosai: yana tsalle, yana dariya, yana motsa hannuwansa. Da ya gama, ya ce, "Yaya ya kasance?" Jauhara ta duba wayar, sai ta yi shiru. Ta ce, "Kai! Na tafka babban kuskure. Ban danna allon da kyau ba. Babu komai a wayar."

Mu'awiya bai yi fushi ba. Ya ce, "Ba laifi. Kowa yakan tafka kuskure. Mu sake." A karo na biyu, Jauhara ta danna allon da kyau. Mu'awiya ya sake yin barkwancin, kuma ya yi shi da kuzari fiye da na farko.

Da yamma, Jauhara ta yi kwafin faifan, ta aika wa abokanta. Abokanta ma suka yi kwafinsa suka aika wa nasu abokai. Kafin mako ya ƙare, mutane dubu ashirin sun kalli faifan.

Bayan kwana ɗaya Malam Barde da kansa ya zo gidansu. Mu'awiya ya ji tsoro, yana tunanin tsohon zai yi fushi. Amma Malam Barde ya yi dariya, ya ce, "Ka yi kwaikwayon kamannina daidai! Har leɓena ka iya kwaikwayo. Kana da hazaka, ɗana."

Bayan kwana uku, wani gidan rediyo a Kano ya kira Mu'awiya. Suka ce suna so ya riƙa yin barkwanci a shirinsu na safiyar Juma'a.

Tambayoyi:
Me Mu'awiya yake so tun yana ƙarami?
Yana son barkwanci tun yana ƙarami.
Me ya sa Mu'awiya ya tsaya a gaban madubi?
Ya tsaya a gaban madubi domin ya yi kwaikwayon kamannin Malam Barde.
Wane kuskure Jauhara ta tafka?
Ba ta danna allon wayar da kyau ba, don haka babu komai a wayar.
Yaya Mu'awiya ya yi barkwancin a karo na biyu?
Ya yi shi da kuzari fiye da na farko.
Me Malam Barde ya ce da ya ga faifan?
Ya ce Mu'awiya ya yi kwaikwayon kamanninsa daidai, kuma yana da hazaka.

lessons.title: Wasiƙun da aka binne
lessons.summary: In Kaduna, Faizu and his father dig in the mud after rain and unearth a metal box with a broken lock; inside are letters his grandfather wrote in purple ink during the civil war, telling how he was frightened, saw a calamity and escaped.
lessons.text:
Bayan ruwan sama mai yawa, Faizu da mahaifinsa sun fita bayan gidansu a Kaduna domin su tona rami su dasa bishiya. Ƙasar ta zama taɓo saboda ruwan. Taɓon ya kama ƙafafunsu da hannuwansu.

Suna cikin tona ramin, sai mahaifinsa ya bugi wani abu mai ƙarfi. Suka ci gaba da tona ƙasar a hankali, sai suka ga wani tsohon akwati na ƙarfe. Akwatin ya cika da taɓo. Mahaifin Faizu ya wanke shi da ruwa. Makullin akwatin ya lalace, don haka suka buɗe shi da sauƙi.

A cikin akwatin akwai wasiƙu goma sha biyu a cikin wata leda. An rubuta su da alƙalami mai launin shuni. Launin shunin bai ɓace ba, ko da yake takardun sun tsufa. Ɗaya daga cikin alƙaluman ma yana cikin akwatin, amma ya lalace. A saman kowace wasiƙa akwai kwanan wata, kamar "Enugu, shekara ta alif da ɗari tara da sittin da bakwai."

Mahaifinsa ya ce, "Waɗannan wasiƙun kakanka ne, Malam Ɗanbazau. Ya rubuta su a lokacin yaƙin basasa." Faizu ya tambaya, "Mene ne yaƙin basasa?" Mahaifinsa ya ce, "Yaƙin basasa yaƙi ne tsakanin mutanen ƙasa ɗaya. A Najeriya an yi yaƙin basasa daga shekara ta alif da ɗari tara da sittin da bakwai zuwa alif da ɗari tara da saba'in."

Suka kai wasiƙun wurin kakar Faizu. Ta karanta wasiƙar farko: "Matata, ina gaishe ki. Ina Enugu, ina tuƙa motar wani ɗan kasuwa. Yaƙin ya fara, kuma mutane sun firgita. Ni ma na firgita, amma kada ki damu."

A wasiƙa ta biyar, kakansa ya rubuta: "Wata masifa ta faru a kasuwar garin nan. An harba bindigogi, kuma mutane da yawa sun mutu. Masifar ta firgita kowa. Ba na iya barci da dare."

A wasiƙar ƙarshe, ya rubuta: "Na kuɓuta! Na bar Enugu da dare tare da wasu direbobi uku. Mun yi tafiya kwana huɗu a cikin daji. Allah ya sa na kuɓuta daga wannan masifa. Zan iso Kaduna kafin Sallah."

Kakar Faizu ta yi murmushi, amma hawaye suna zuba daga idanunta. Ta ce, "Bayan ya kuɓuta, ya dawo gida lafiya. Sai ya sa wasiƙun nan a cikin akwati ya binne su, domin ba ya so ya sake tunawa da yaƙin."

Faizu ya ɗauki alƙalaminsa ya rubuta labarin kakansa a littafinsa.

Tambayoyi:
Me ya sa ƙasar ta zama taɓo?
Ƙasar ta zama taɓo saboda ruwan sama mai yawa.
Me suka gani a lokacin da suke tona rami?
Sun ga wani tsohon akwati na ƙarfe.
Da me aka rubuta wasiƙun?
An rubuta su da alƙalami mai launin shuni.
Mene ne yaƙin basasa?
Yaƙin basasa yaƙi ne tsakanin mutanen ƙasa ɗaya.
Yaya kakan Faizu ya kuɓuta?
Ya bar Enugu da dare tare da wasu direbobi uku, suka yi tafiya kwana huɗu a cikin daji.

lessons.title: Shirin cinikayya a rediyo
lessons.summary: On a Kaduna radio programme about trade, an analyst says foreign rice floods the markets while a Kano rice trader disagrees and shows two samples; a listener calls in, and in the end all agree on one position: help local farmers.
lessons.text:
Bahiyya tana gabatar da wani shiri a gidan rediyo a Kaduna kowace Talata. Sunan shirin "Cinikayya a Yau". A cikin shirin, ana tattauna batun cinikayya tsakanin Najeriya da ƙasashe maƙwabta.

A wannan mako, ta gayyaci baƙi biyu. Na farko shi ne Dakta Abdulmajid, wani manazarci a wata jami'a a Kaduna, wanda yake nazarin harkokin cinikayya. Na biyu shi ne Alhaji Yakasai, wani babban ɗan kasuwa daga Kano wanda yake sayar da shinkafa.

Bahiyya ta fara da tambaya: "Dakta, a matsayinka na manazarci, me kake gani game da kayan da suke kwarara cikin ƙasar nan daga waje?"

Dakta Abdulmajid ya ce, "Kaya da yawa suna kwarara daga ƙasashen waje. Akasarin shinkafar da ake sayarwa a kasuwanninmu daga waje take zuwa. Ƙalilan ne kawai daga cikin manomanmu suke sayar da shinkafarsu a manyan kasuwanni. Sanadin haka shi ne, shinkafar waje ta fi sauƙin kuɗi."

Alhaji Yakasai ya ce, "Na saɓa da wannan matsaya, Dakta. Hasali ma, shinkafar gida ta fi ta waje daɗi, kuma yanzu akasarin masu saye a shagona suna son ta. Masu sayen shinkafar waje ne ƙalilan."

Bahiyya ta ce, "To, ga matsaya biyu ke nan. Dakta ya ce shinkafar waje tana kwarara, Alhaji kuma ya saɓa da shi."

Alhaji Yakasai ya fito da ƙananan jakunkuna biyu daga aljihunsa. Ya ce, "Na zo da samfur guda biyu. Wannan samfurin shinkafar gida ne, wannan kuma samfurin shinkafar waje." Bahiyya ta duba samfuran biyu, ta ce, "Samfurin shinkafar gida ya fi tsabta."

Sai masu sauraro suka fara kira ta waya. Wata mata daga Zaria ta ce, "Bayanin Dakta bai gamsar da ni ba. Hasali ma, jiya na sayi shinkafar gida a farashi mai sauƙi."

Dakta Abdulmajid ya yi murmushi, ya ce, "Bayanin Alhaji da na wannan baiwar Allah sun gamsar da ni a wani ɓangare. Amma sanadin matsalar shi ne, manomanmu ba su da kayan aiki na zamani. Ina ganin za mu iya samun matsaya ɗaya: a taimaka wa manoman gida, domin cinikayyarsu ta ƙaru."

Alhaji Yakasai ya ce, "Wannan matsaya ta gamsar da ni." A ƙarshen shirin, Bahiyya ta gode wa baƙinta.

Tambayoyi:
Wane ne Dakta Abdulmajid?
Shi manazarci ne a wata jami'a a Kaduna, wanda yake nazarin harkokin cinikayya.
Me Dakta ya ce game da shinkafar waje?
Ya ce tana kwarara cikin ƙasar, kuma akasarin shinkafar kasuwanni daga waje take zuwa.
Me Alhaji Yakasai ya kawo a cikin aljihunsa?
Ya kawo samfur guda biyu: samfurin shinkafar gida da na shinkafar waje.
Me ya sa bayanin Dakta bai gamsar da matar Zaria ba?
Domin jiya ta sayi shinkafar gida a farashi mai sauƙi.
Wace matsaya kowa ya yarda da ita a ƙarshe?
Kowa ya yarda a taimaka wa manoman gida, domin cinikayyarsu ta ƙaru.

lessons.title: Nadiya a ofishin jakadanci
lessons.summary: Nadiya from Kano needs a visa for a university in England; she buys health insurance and writes a short CV, is held up by a traffic jam in Abuja, gives her excuse to the embassy secretary, signs the forms in a hurry and follows up her application until it is approved.
lessons.text:
Nadiya 'yar shekara ashirin da biyu ce daga Kano. Ta sami gurbin karatu a wata jami'a a Ingila. Kafin ta tafi, dole ne ta sami izinin shiga ƙasar daga ofishin jakadancin Ingila a Abuja.

Ofishin jakadancin ya aika mata saƙo ta waya cewa ta zo ranar Litinin ƙarfe tara na safe. Saƙon ya ce ta zo da fasfo, da lasisin tuƙi ko wani katin shaida, da takardar inshorar lafiya, da kuma taƙaitaccen tarihin rayuwarta.

Ranar Lahadi Nadiya ta shirya takardunta. Ta je wani kamfanin inshora a Kano ta biya kuɗin inshorar lafiya ta shekara ɗaya. Ma'aikacin kamfanin inshorar ya ba ta takarda. Sannan ta ɗauki lasisinta na tuƙi, ta rubuta taƙaitaccen tarihinta: makarantun da ta yi, da aikin da ta taɓa yi.

Ranar Litinin ta hau mota zuwa Abuja da asuba. Amma a ƙofar birnin akwai cunkoso mai yawa. Motoci suna tsaye, ba sa motsi. Cunkoson ya ɗauki awa biyu. Nadiya ta isa ofishin jakadancin ƙarfe goma da rabi.

Da ta shiga, ta sami sakatariyar ofishin a bayan wani babban tebur. Nadiya ta ce, "Ki yi haƙuri, na makara. Uzurina shi ne cunkoson da ke hanya." Sakatariyar ta ce, "Na ji uzurinki. Mutane da yawa suna kawo uzurin cunkoso, domin cunkoso ya zama ruwan dare a Abuja. Amma ki gaggauta, domin za mu rufe ƙarfe goma sha biyu."

Sakatariyar ta ba ta takardu uku. Ta ce, "Ki cike waɗannan, sannan ki rattaɓa hannu a ƙasan kowace takarda." Nadiya ta gaggauta ta cike su, ta rattaɓa hannu a kansu. Sakatariyar ta duba lasisinta da fasfonta da takardar inshorarta. Ta karanta taƙaitaccen tarihinta, ta ce, "Taƙaitaccen tarihinki yana da kyau."

Da ta gama, sakatariyar ta ce, "Za mu duba takardunki. Bayan mako biyu, ki bibiyi buƙatarki a shafinmu. Idan ba ki ga komai ba, ki kira mu."

Bayan mako biyu, Nadiya ta bibiyi buƙatarta a shafin ofishin, amma ba ta ga komai ba. Sai ta kira ofishin jakadancin domin ta ci gaba da bibiyar buƙatarta. Sakatariyar ce ta amsa wayar, ta ce, "An amince da buƙatarki. Ki zo ki karɓi fasfonki ranar Alhamis."

Ranar Alhamis Nadiya ta bar Kano da asuba, domin kada cunkoso ya sake hana ta isa da wuri.

Tambayoyi:
Me ya sa Nadiya za ta je ofishin jakadanci?
Domin ta sami izinin shiga Ingila, inda ta sami gurbin karatu.
Wace takarda ta karɓa daga kamfanin inshora?
Ta karɓi takardar inshorar lafiya ta shekara ɗaya.
Me ya sa ta makara?
Ta makara saboda cunkoson da ke ƙofar birnin Abuja.
Me sakatariyar ta ce ta yi a ƙasan kowace takarda?
Ta ce ta rattaɓa hannu a ƙasan kowace takarda.
Yaya Nadiya ta bibiyi buƙatarta?
Ta duba shafin ofishin, sannan ta kira ofishin jakadancin ta waya.

lessons.title: Zomo da Maciji
lessons.summary: On a Sokoto radio programme, a storyteller tells children how a greedy Hare cut down the Snake's tree, destroying his own young plants and the Snake's home; hatred and a wish for revenge follow, until on a stormy night lit by lightning the Hare takes the Snake in and they become friends.
lessons.text:
Kowane daren Lahadi, Malam Junaidu yana ba da tatsuniya a wani gidan rediyo a Sokoto. Ga tatsuniyar da ya bayar a makon jiya.

A zamanin da, Zomo da Maciji maƙwabta ne a wani daji. Zomo yana da gona, kuma Maciji yana zaune a wani rami a ƙarƙashin wata babbar bishiya kusa da gonar.

Zomo yana da kwaɗayi sosai. Duk abin da ya gani, yana so ya zama nasa. A lokacin damina ya shuka dawa a gonarsa, kuma ƙananan tsiro suka fito. Kowace safiya yana duba tsiron dawarsa yana farin ciki.

Wata rana Zomo ya hango 'ya'yan itace masu yawa a saman bishiyar Maciji. Kwaɗayi ya kama shi. Ya ce, "Duk waɗannan 'ya'yan itace nawa ne. Zan sare bishiyar, sai 'ya'yan su faɗo ƙasa."

Maciji ya fito daga ramin ya ce, "Zomo, kada ka sare bishiyar nan. Gidana yana ƙarƙashinta. Idan ka sare ta, za ta faɗa a kan tsironka."

Zomo ya yi dariya, ya ce, "Kai shashasha ne, Maciji. Ba ka san komai ba." Sai ya ɗauki gatari ya sare bishiyar. Bishiyar ta faɗi, ta rufe ramin Maciji, kuma ta faɗa a kan tsiron Zomo, ta lalata su duka. Ashe Zomo ne shashasha, ba Maciji ba.

Tun daga ranar, ƙiyayya ta shiga tsakaninsu. Maciji ya ce, "Zan ɗauki fansa. Zomo ya lalata gidana, ni ma zan lalata nasa."

Bayan kwana uku, an yi guguwa da ruwan sama mai ƙarfi da dare. Walƙiya ta yi, sai Zomo ya hango wani abu a ƙofar gidansa. Walƙiya ta sake yi, sai ya ga Maciji ne, yana rawar sanyi a cikin ruwan sama. Maciji ba shi da gida.

Zomo ya tuna da abin da ya yi. Ya ce, "Maciji, kai ba shashasha ba ne. Ni ne na yi kuskure saboda kwaɗayina. Shigo gidana, kada ka ji sanyi." Maciji ya shiga. Ya ce, "Na zo ne domin in ɗauki fansa, amma ka nuna min alheri. Ba zan ɗauki fansa ba."

Tun daga lokacin, ƙiyayyar ta ƙare, suka zama abokai.

Malam Junaidu ya ce wa yara, "Kwaɗayi yakan kawo masifa, kuma ƙiyayya da fansa ba sa gyara komai."

Tambayoyi:
Me ya sa Zomo ya so ya sare bishiyar?
Domin ya hango 'ya'yan itace masu yawa a samanta, kuma kwaɗayi ya kama shi.
Me Maciji ya ce wa Zomo?
Ya ce kada ya sare bishiyar, domin gidansa yana ƙarƙashinta.
Me ya faru da tsiron Zomo?
Bishiyar ta faɗa a kan tsiron, ta lalata su duka.
Me Zomo ya gani a lokacin da walƙiya ta yi?
Ya hango Maciji a ƙofar gidansa, yana rawar sanyi.
Me ya sa Maciji bai ɗauki fansa ba?
Domin Zomo ya nuna masa alheri, ya ba shi wuri a gidansa.

lessons.title: Kirsimeti a majami'ar Jos
lessons.summary: In Jos, Lidiya's church celebrates Christmas and its fiftieth anniversary; her Sunday-school teacher reads a chapter about the birth of Jesus, Lidiya plays the angel in a silk dress while her brother plays the piano, lights shine over the church, and a feast follows.
lessons.text:
Lidiya 'yar shekara goma sha biyu ce, kuma tana zaune a Jos tare da iyayenta da ɗan'uwanta Ishaku. Kowace Lahadi tana zuwa majami'ar da ke kusa da gidansu. Malama Marta tana karantar da yara a majami'ar bayan ibada.

A ƙarshen shekara, Malama Marta ta ce wa yara, "Kirsimeti na bana na musamman ne. Za a yi zagayowar shekara hamsin da kafuwar majami'armu. Za mu yi babban shagali, kuma ku yara za ku yi wasan kwaikwayo."

Malama Marta ta buɗe Littafi Mai Tsarki, ta karanta wani babi game da haihuwar Yesu. A cikin babin, wani mala'ika ya zo wurin masu kiwo da dare, ya faɗa musu labarin haihuwar yaron. Masu kiwon suka je suka gurfana a gaban jaririn. Malama Marta ta karantar da su ma'anar babin, sannan ta ce, "Lidiya, ke za ki zama mala'ika. Waɗannan yara uku za su zama masu kiwo, kuma za su gurfana a gaban jaririn."

Mahaifiyar Lidiya ta sayi zanen siliki fari a kasuwa, ta ɗinka mata doguwar riga. Rigar siliki tana da laushi sosai. Lidiya ta sa rigar siliki, ta yi kyau kamar mala'ika na gaske.

Ishaku yana koyon fiyano. Fasto Yohanna ya ce Ishaku zai buga fiyano a lokacin wasan. Kowace yamma Ishaku yana buga fiyano a majami'ar, Lidiya kuma tana karanta maganar mala'ikan har ta riƙe ta a ka.

Kafin Kirsimeti, matasa suka sa fitilu masu launi a kewayen majami'ar. Da dare ya yi, fitilun suka haska majami'ar, ta yi kyau sosai. Hasken ya haska har titin da ke gabanta.

Ranar Kirsimeti, majami'ar ta cika da mutane. Fasto Yohanna ya yi magana game da zagayowar shekara hamsin. Ya ce, "A wannan zagayowa, muna gode wa Allah." Sannan wasan ya fara. Ishaku ya buga fiyano a hankali. Lidiya ta shigo cikin rigarta ta siliki, ta ɗaga hannu ta ce, "Kada ku ji tsoro! Na kawo muku labari mai daɗi." Masu kiwo uku suka gurfana a gaban wani ƙaramin gado inda aka kwantar da jaririn.

Bayan ibada, aka yi shagali a farfajiyar majami'ar. An ci shinkafa da nama, yara suna rawa, manya kuma suna gaisawa. Shagalin ya ci gaba har dare. Malama Marta ta ce wa Lidiya, "Kin zama mala'ika na gaske a yau."

Tambayoyi:
Wa yake karantar da yara a majami'ar?
Malama Marta ce take karantar da yara a majami'ar bayan ibada.
Me ya sa Kirsimeti na bana yake na musamman?
Domin za a yi zagayowar shekara hamsin da kafuwar majami'ar.
Me masu kiwo suka yi a cikin babin?
Sun je sun gurfana a gaban jaririn.
Wa ya buga fiyano a lokacin wasan?
Ishaku ne ya buga fiyano.
Me ya haska majami'ar da dare?
Fitilu masu launi ne suka haska majami'ar.

lessons.title: Wasiƙa zuwa Jidda
lessons.summary: From Katsina, Jalila writes to her husband in Jidda about raising their two-month-old son: feeding him at night, mosquitoes and the net she bought, the alms given at the naming, the price of onions, his parcel that arrived, and the question of when he will come back.
lessons.text:
Katsina, 14 ga Afrilu

Zuwa ga mijina Abdurrazak a Jidda,

Assalamu alaikum. Ina fatan kana lafiya a can. Mu ma muna lafiya, ni da ɗanmu Abdulnasir. Kwanannan na ji muryarka a waya, amma na ga ya kamata in rubuta maka wasiƙa mai tsawo, domin in faɗa maka komai.

Da farko, na sami aikenka. Aiken ya iso ranar Laraba ta hannun abokinka da ya dawo daga Jidda: kuɗin da ka turo da tufafin jariri guda biyar. Mun gode sosai. Aikenka ya zo a lokacin da ya dace.

Abdulnasir yanzu yana da wata biyu. Renon jariri ba abu ne mai sauƙi ba. Yana tashi sau uku ko huɗu da dare yana kuka, sai in ba shi nono. Likita ta ce in ba shi nono kawai har ya kai wata shida. Mahaifiyata tana taimaka min da renonsa. Ta ce, "Reno yana buƙatar haƙuri."

Kwanannan an sami sauro da yawa a unguwarmu saboda ruwan sama. Sauro yana cizon mutane da dare, kuma likita ta ce cizon sauro yana kawo zazzaɓi. Don haka na sayi gidan sauro, ina sa Abdulnasir a ciki idan zai yi barci.

Ka tuna cewa a ranar sunan Abdulnasir, mun yi sadaka. Mahaifiyata ta dafa tuwon alkama da miya, aka raba sadakar ga talakawa. Mun kuma ba da sadakar kuɗi a masallaci. Har yanzu mutane suna yi mana addu'a saboda wannan sadaka.

Farashin kaya ya tashi a kasuwa. Albasa ta yi tsada sosai: kwandon albasa ɗaya ya kai naira dubu goma, kuma kowa yana kokawa da farashin albasa. Alkama ma ta yi tsada. Saboda haka ba na dafa abinci mai yawa, sai dai abin da muke buƙata.

Kafin ka tafi, ka ce ni ce uwargidan gidan nan, kuma ni ce zan riƙe gida. Na riƙe shi, amma yanzu Abdulnasir ne shugaban gida! Uwargidan maƙwabcinmu tana zuwa kowace safiya ta duba mu. Ta ce Abdulnasir yana kama da kai.

Yaushe za ka dawo gida? Mahaifiyarka ta ce idan ka dawo, za ta yi maka liyafa. Ni kuma ina so ka dawo kafin Abdulnasir ya fara tafiya, domin ka gan shi.

Ka gaida abokanka. Allah ya kiyaye ka.

Matarka,
Jalila

Tambayoyi:
Me ya zo a cikin aiken Abdurrazak?
Kuɗi da tufafin jariri guda biyar ne suka zo a cikin aikensa.
Me mahaifiyar Jalila ta ce game da reno?
Ta ce reno yana buƙatar haƙuri.
Me ya sa Jalila ta sayi gidan sauro?
Domin sauro da yawa sun zo unguwarsu, kuma cizon sauro yana kawo zazzaɓi.
Me aka dafa a ranar sunan Abdulnasir?
An dafa tuwon alkama da miya, aka raba sadakar ga talakawa.
Me ya sa Jalila take so mijinta ya dawo da wuri?
Tana so ya dawo kafin Abdulnasir ya fara tafiya, domin ya gan shi.

lessons.title: Wasiƙa zuwa ga editan jarida
lessons.summary: A Kano cloth trader writes to a newspaper: at a meeting of traders the market authority promised new stalls within three months, but after the old ones were pulled down the building has been postponed three times, and the temporary stalls stand beside a dirty drain whose smell drives buyers away; he asks that the work be given priority.
lessons.text:
Zuwa ga editan jaridarku,

Ranka ya daɗe, ina so in yi amfani da jaridarku domin in jawo hankalin hukumar Kasuwar Sabon Gari a Kano ga wata matsala da mu 'yan kasuwa muke fama da ita.

Ni ɗan kasuwa ne. Shekara ashirin ke nan ina sayar da zannuwa a wata ƙaramar rumfa a kasuwar. A farkon shekarar nan, hukumar kasuwa ta kira taron 'yan kasuwa a ofishinta. A wurin taron, shugaban hukumar ya ce za a rushe tsofaffin rumfuna, a gina sababbi masu kyau. Ya ce aikin zai ɗauki wata uku kawai, kuma kafin a gama, za mu zauna a rumfunan wucin gadi.

An rushe rumfunanmu, amma har yanzu ba a fara gina sababbin ba. Da farko an ce za a fara aikin bayan Sallah. Sai aka dage shi zuwa damina. Sai aka sake dage shi zuwa ƙarshen shekara. Yanzu an dage aikin sau uku, kuma babu wanda ya faɗa mana dalili.

Rumfunan wucin gadin da aka ba mu suna gefen wata babbar magudana. Ruwan magudanar gurɓatacce ne, kuma yana wari sosai. Duk wanda ya zo saye yana shaƙar warin, sai ya juya ya tafi. Mu kuma muna shaƙar warin daga safe har yamma, kuma wasu daga cikinmu sun fara tari. Ba a tsaftace magudanar ba tun da muka zo wurin. Idan aka yi ruwan sama, gurɓataccen ruwan yana kwarara zuwa cikin rumfunanmu, yana lalata kayanmu.

Ina roƙon hukumar ta ba wannan matsala fifiko. Na farko, a tsaftace magudanar da ke gefen rumfunan wucin gadi, domin a daƙile cututtuka. Na biyu, a ba gina sababbin rumfuna fifiko, kuma kada a sake dage aikin. Idan ba a daƙile wannan matsala da wuri ba, 'yan kasuwa da yawa za su rasa abin da suke ci.

Mu 'yan kasuwa a shirye muke mu taimaka. Za mu iya tsaftace gaban rumfunanmu da kanmu, idan hukumar ta ba mu kayan aiki. Muna kuma roƙon hukumar ta sake kiran taron 'yan kasuwa, domin ta faɗa mana gaskiyar abin da yake faruwa.

Na gode.

Habibullahi Kumbotso,
Kasuwar Sabon Gari, Kano

Tambayoyi:
Me shugaban hukumar ya ce a wurin taron 'yan kasuwa?
Ya ce za a rushe tsofaffin rumfuna a gina sababbi, kuma aikin zai ɗauki wata uku kawai.
Sau nawa aka dage aikin?
An dage aikin sau uku.
Ina rumfunan wucin gadin suke?
Suna gefen wata babbar magudana mai gurɓataccen ruwa.
Me ya sa masu saye suke juyawa su tafi?
Domin suna shaƙar warin magudanar.
Me Habibullahi yake roƙon hukumar ta ba fifiko?
Yana roƙonta ta tsaftace magudanar, kuma ta ba gina sababbin rumfuna fifiko.

lessons.title: Gasar hadisi a talabijin
lessons.summary: In Sokoto, Hasina, who wants to become a teacher, enters a television hadith contest before Ramadan; her little brother follows her everywhere, her mother helps her put on a new hijab, and on the day she barely remembers the fourth hadith but just wins.
lessons.text:
Hasina 'yar shekara goma sha uku ce daga Sokoto. Tun tana 'yar shekara bakwai take karatun hadisi a wata makarantar allo. Tana da aniyar ta zama malama wata rana.

Wani gidan talabijin a Sokoto yana shirya gasar hadisi kowace shekara gabanin watan Ramadan. A gasar, kowane ɗalibi yakan lissafa hadisan da ya riƙe a ka, sannan ya bayyana ma'anarsu. A bana Hasina ta yi aniyar shiga gasar.

Gabanin gasar, ta yi ta karatu kowace rana. Ƙaninta Abdulbaki, mai shekara takwas, yana bin ta duk inda ta je, yana sauraron hadisan da take karantawa. Idan ta manta wani abu, sai ya ce, "Kin manta!" Hasina ta ce, "Kai, ka daina bin bayana kamar inuwa!" Amma tana dariya.

Ranar gasar, mahaifiyarta ta taimaka mata ta sa sabon mayafi shuɗi. Sun ɗauki lokaci kafin su sa mayafin, domin hannuwan Hasina suna rawa. Mahaifiyarta ta ce, "Ki shaƙi iska a hankali. Komai zai yi kyau." Abdulbaki ma ya bi su zuwa gidan talabijin.

A ɗakin gasar, sai aka kira sunan Hasina. Ta yi taku goma zuwa gaban alƙalai. A kowane taku, tana jin zuciyarta tana bugawa da ƙarfi. Wani alƙali ya ce, "Ki lissafa hadisai biyar game da gaskiya."

Hasina ta fara lissafa su ɗaya bayan ɗaya. Ta faɗi hadisi na farko, da na biyu, da na uku. Amma da ta zo kan hadisi na huɗu, sai ya ɓace mata. Ta yi shiru. Sai ta hango Abdulbaki a cikin masu kallo, yana motsa leɓensa a hankali. Da ƙyar ta tuna farkon hadisin. Ta faɗi shi, sannan ta faɗi na biyar.

Da aka gama, alƙalan suka lissafa makin kowane ɗalibi. Da ƙyar Hasina ta ci gasar: ta sami maki casa'in da tara, ɗalibi na biyu kuma ya sami casa'in da takwas.

Da suka dawo gida, Hasina ta ce wa ƙaninta, "Na gode. Daga yau, ka yi ta bin bayana duk inda na je!"

Tambayoyi:
Wace aniya Hasina take da ita?
Tana da aniyar ta zama malama wata rana.
Yaushe ake yin gasar hadisi a talabijin?
Ana yin ta kowace shekara gabanin watan Ramadan.
Me alƙali ya ce Hasina ta lissafa?
Ya ce ta lissafa hadisai biyar game da gaskiya.
Me ya faru da hadisi na huɗu?
Ya ɓace mata, kuma da ƙyar ta tuna shi.
Wa ya taimaka mata ta tuna hadisin?
Ƙaninta Abdulbaki ne, wanda yake bin ta, yana motsa leɓensa.

lessons.title: Saƙon matukin jirgi
lessons.summary: A Kano youth football coach flies with his players to a tournament in Lagos; when the plane tilts in a storm, confusion breaks out, the coach takes charge, and the pilot, a Hausa man, calms the boys by speaking to them in Hausa.
lessons.text:
Yusha'u koci ne na wata ƙungiyar ƙwallon ƙafa ta matasa a Kano. 'Yan wasansa goma sha takwas ne, kuma akasarinsu ba su taɓa hawa jirgin sama ba. A bana ƙungiyar ta sami damar zuwa gasar ƙasa a Legas, kuma za su tafi da jirgin sama.

Da safe suka isa filin jirgin sama na Kano. 'Yan wasan suna farin ciki, amma wasu suna jin tsoro. Koci Yusha'u ya ce musu, "Kada ku damu. Jirgin sama ya fi mota lafiya."

Da suka shiga jirgin, sai matukin jirgin ya yi magana. Ya ce, "Barkanku da zuwa. Ni ne Kyaftin Ɗanmaliki, matukin jirgin nan." Ya yi magana da Turanci, sannan ya maimaita da Hausa. 'Yan wasan suka yi mamaki. Ɗaya daga cikinsu ya ce, "Koci, matukin jirgin Bahaushe ne!" Kocin ya ce, "Haka ne, akwai Hausawa da yawa da suke tuƙa jiragen sama."

Bayan minti arba'in, jirgin ya shiga cikin guguwa. Jirgin ya fara girgiza, sai ya karkata gefe ɗaya, sannan ya karkata ɗaya gefen. Ruɗani ya shiga tsakanin 'yan wasan. Wasu suka tashi daga kujerunsu, wasu suna kuka, wasu kuma suna ihu.

Koci Yusha'u ya riƙe ragamar 'yan wasansa. Ya tashi ya ce, "Kowa ya zauna a kujerarsa! Ruɗani ba zai taimake mu ba."

Sai matukin jirgin ya sake magana da Hausa: "Ina yi muku magana daga gaban jirgi. Jirgin yana karkata saboda iska mai ƙarfi. Babu wani haɗari. Ku huce, ku zauna a kujerunku." Da 'yan wasan suka ji muryar Bahaushen matukin, sai suka huce. Ruɗanin ya ƙare.

Bayan minti goma, jirgin ya fita daga guguwar, ya daina karkata. Koci Yusha'u ya ce, "Kun gani? Idan kun huce, komai yana tafiya daidai. Haka ma a filin wasa: idan kun shiga ruɗani, za ku yi rashin nasara."

Da jirgin ya sauka a Legas, Kyaftin Ɗanmaliki ya fito ya same su. Ya ce, "Na ji cewa akwai ƙungiyar ƙwallo a cikin jirgina." Kocin ya ce, "Mun gode. Muryarka ce ta sa yaran suka huce."

Bayan kwana biyar, ƙungiyar ta ci gasar. Koci Yusha'u ya aika wa matukin jirgin saƙo ta waya: "Mun ci! Na gode da ka taimaka mana a cikin jirgi."

Tambayoyi:
Wane ne Yusha'u?
Shi koci ne na wata ƙungiyar ƙwallon ƙafa ta matasa a Kano.
Me ya sa 'yan wasan suka yi mamaki da matukin ya yi magana?
Domin ya maimaita maganarsa da Hausa, kuma Bahaushe ne.
Me ya faru da jirgin ya shiga cikin guguwa?
Jirgin ya karkata gefe ɗaya da ɗaya gefen, kuma ruɗani ya shiga tsakanin 'yan wasan.
Yaya koci ya riƙe ragamar 'yan wasansa?
Ya tashi ya ce kowa ya zauna a kujerarsa.
Me ya sa 'yan wasan suka huce?
Sun huce da suka ji muryar Bahaushen matukin jirgin a cikin Hausa.
